Markdown variant cache poisoning, before and after

orchestkit.yonyon.ai serves two representations at one URL: HTML for people, Markdown for agents that send Accept: text/markdown or a known crawler User-Agent. That is content negotiation, and it is only safe while every cache in the path honours Vary. Pick a cache and a reader to see what each one stores and serves.

Why private and not a longer Vary list

      
A shared cache that ignores Vary cannot be fixed by adding tokens to Vary. Marking the negotiated
      body private forbids shared storage outright, and Vercel-CDN-Cache-Control gives Vercel's own edge back its
      TTL, since that header is exclusive to Vercel, takes priority for its cache, and is consumed rather than forwarded. Vercel's cache was
      never the risk: it keys on the post-middleware destination, so /docs/x and /api/md/x are separate entries.
